info.name: Hang Partner API (params in:formData) Activities Programs API
Fetch all tiers and corresponding benefits for the program linked to the API key used in the request.

items.docs: Tiers represent a status level that a user can achieve based on their activity within a loyalty program. Each tier has a minimum threshold that a user must reach before being able to unlock the tier.
